Name: Improved MAP for fishing farms
Author: tikamin557
Description:
The farm was slightly enlarged and the lawn was reduced.
The bridge has been widened to make traveling by horse comfortable.

Minecarts, and shortcuts can be enabled/disabled from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url] settings.
